summary: Light theme fix testing completed successfully. All 8 requested features tested and verified. Fixed one bug: hero text 'ENGINEERING' was being affected by global light theme CSS override - changed from className to inline style to ensure it always stays white.

features_tested.feature: Theme toggle switches between dark and light modes
features_tested.details: Toggle correctly applies 'light' or 'dark' class to html element. Theme persists via localStorage.

features_tested.feature: Hero section (video overlay) remains dark/cinematic regardless of theme
features_tested.details: HeroVideoPlayer always uses dark gradient overlay (from-[#050508]) - not affected by theme toggle.

features_tested.feature: Hero text 'ENGINEERING BRILLIANCE' is always white with text shadow for readability
features_tested.details: Fixed: Changed from className='text-white' to inline style={{ color: '#ffffff' }} to prevent CSS override. Text shadow applied via parent h1 element.

features_tested.feature: Header navigation is readable in both dark and light modes
features_tested.details: Navbar uses rgba(255,255,255,0.95) background in light mode with dark text (rgb(82, 82, 82)) for proper contrast.

features_tested.feature: Navbar dropdown menus have proper theming (dark in dark mode, white in light mode)
features_tested.details: Dropdown uses panelStyle object with isDark conditional - white bg (rgba(255,255,255,0.98)) and dark text in light mode.

features_tested.feature: Products page properly adapts to light theme (light background, dark text)
features_tested.details: Products page uses slate-50 background (rgb(248, 250, 252)) with dark text (neutral-900) in light mode via useTheme hook.

features_tested.feature: Product cards show proper contrast in both themes
features_tested.details: Cards use white background (rgb(255, 255, 255)) with neutral-200 border and dark text in light mode.

features_tested.feature: Search inputs and filters are themed correctly
features_tested.details: Search input uses white background with dark text (rgb(10, 10, 13)) and proper border styling in light mode.

bug_fixed.description: Hero text 'ENGINEERING' was turning dark in light mode
bug_fixed.root_cause: App.css has global rule 'html.light .text-white { color: #0a0a0d !important; }' which was overriding the hero text className
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Changed hero text from className='text-white' to inline style={{ color: '#ffffff' }} in Home.js line 315

critical_code_review_comments: Home.js: HeroVideoPlayer correctly has fixed dark gradients that don't use isDark prop - good separation of hero cinematic styling from page theme.
Navbar.js: panelStyle properly uses isDark conditional for dropdown backgrounds - correct implementation.
Products.js: Properly uses useTheme hook and applies theme-aware classes throughout component.
App.css: Global light theme overrides are working but caused hero text issue - consider adding hero-specific exclusion class in future for cleaner solution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Light theme implementation is complete and working. Hero section always stays dark/cinematic regardless of theme. Products page and navbar dropdowns properly adapt to light theme. One small fix applied: hero text now uses inline style to prevent global CSS override.
